headline: Bionaturista Expands Food Plant and Relunches Cosmetics Line
summary: Peruvian natural products manufacturer Bionaturista is expanding its production capacity and relaunching its cosmetics line with a focus on international markets.
why: Production capacity expansion enables consumer goods companies to scale export volumes and meet growing global demand.

impacts.name: Bionaturista
impacts.why: Increased manufacturing capacity directly supports higher sales volumes across domestic and international retail channels.
